# Copilot Agent Instructions — TylrDn/CODE

This file is auto-loaded by GitHub Copilot for every session in this repo.
Do NOT remove or rename it. Keep it as the single source of truth for agent behavior.

---

## Identity & Role

You are a coding agent operating inside the TylrDn swarm governance system.
This repo (`CODE`) is the **control plane** — it contains conventions, templates,
and indexes that all other repos inherit. You are not building features here;
you are maintaining infrastructure for other agents to build features.

---

## Repo Map

```
.github/
  copilot-instructions.md   ← you are here (auto-loaded)
  ISSUE_TEMPLATE/           ← spec intake templates
  workflows/                ← reusable CI + session-log automation
agent/
  agent-init-block.md       ← legacy paste-in init (superseded by this file)
  commit-conventions.md     ← Conventional Commits rules
  copilot-instructions-template.md  ← copy this to .github/ in new repos
  review-protocol.md        ← PR review gate rules
  swarm-prompt.md           ← re-entry prompt for Copilot sessions
repo-index/
  TEMPLATE.md               ← schema for registering a new repo
  *.md                      ← one file per registered repo
session-log/
  *.md                      ← auto-generated on PR merge
bootstrap.sh                ← sets up a new repo to use this swarm
```

---

## Non-Negotiable Rules

1. **PR-only workflow** — never push directly to `main`. All changes via PR.
2. **Conventional Commits** — see `agent/commit-conventions.md`. Every commit message must conform.
3. **One concern per PR** — no bundling unrelated changes.
4. **Review gate** — see `agent/review-protocol.md`. Do not merge without passing checks.
5. **Update repo-index** — if you add, remove, or materially change a registered repo's structure, update its `repo-index/<repo>.md`.
6. **Session log** — auto-generated by GitHub Actions on merge. Do not create manually.

---

## When Working on This Repo

- Treat every file in `agent/` as a **template or spec**, not executable code.
- When updating `copilot-instructions-template.md`, also check if `CODE`'s own `.github/copilot-instructions.md` needs the same change.
- When adding a new workflow to `.github/workflows/`, document it in this file under the Repo Map above.
- `bootstrap.sh` must remain idempotent — always test that running it twice on the same repo produces no diff.

---

## Registering a New Repo

1. Copy `repo-index/TEMPLATE.md` → `repo-index/<repo-name>.md` and fill it out.
2. Copy `agent/copilot-instructions-template.md` → `<new-repo>/.github/copilot-instructions.md` and customize.
3. Run `bootstrap.sh <repo-name>` to wire up CODEOWNERS, issue templates, and the CI workflow reference.
4. Open a PR in CODE with the new `repo-index/<repo-name>.md`.
